main.Title: On the verge of becoming a full-stack developer — graduating soon.
main.Description: Hi, I'm Gabriel Mornard. Passionate about building clean, functional web and mobile experiences.

project1.title: Task Manager App
project1.description: A web application to create, assign and track tasks across projects. Built with Angular on the frontend and a .NET REST API backed by MSSQL.

project2.title: Mobile App
project2.description: An Android application built with Java, featuring real-time data sync through Firebase and a clean material design interface.

contact.description: I'm actively looking for opportunities. Whether you have a question, a project idea, or just want to say hi — my inbox is open.
